name: Saehata Sara
source: [url=/c44220]Yuuma[/url]'s homeroom teacher who also teaches English. She can be quite airheaded at times. She initially assigned Yuuma as the student council secretary as she is the advisor for the student council and wanted to find a way to push her duties onto Yuuma. Quickly, she becomes the advisor for the second literature club as well.
